verdicts.claim: relic_yield retrospective r_max = 0.0897 (omega_h <= 0.12), CONFIRMED by reach
verdicts.reason: Own s0 = 2891.2 cm^-3, Y_B = 8.6734e-11: (E/Q) r = 5.0422 GeV; with e = m*/m_X = 0.56234, r = 0.089664; omega_asym = 1.33832 r. It is a rigorous upper edge because any hidden state has e_eff >= m*.

verdicts.claim: reach: all-DM calibration fixes only e*gX*v*r = 5.042 GeV; r in [0.0504, 0.0897]; Codex-like cold Q-balls need 0.055-0.071 (correcting the 'r ~ 0.09' framing)
verdicts.reason: Product and band edges reproduced (5.0422 GeV; 0.05042-0.08966), so 'r ~ 0.09' is indeed only the Q-matter edge. But (i) released binding energy stays as stable hidden h / X quanta (m_h < 2 m_X, XX->hh closed, no massless state), so e_eff lies between the Q-ball value and the supplied state's e (0.9442 at the Codex density); (ii) the charge-weighted Codex lump is Q = 6.19e5 (e = 0.6958, r = 0.0725) and the largest Q = 1.52e6 (e = 0.6593, r = 0.0765), while the track used e(5e5). Codex-like range is 0.053-0.077. The lower edge 0.0504 holds only if the hidden density is the net charge alone.

verdicts.claim: reach: thin-wall binding threshold Q ~ 1.3e4 [E] (charge_phase) corrected to 1.77e4; dQ/dOmega < 0 over 1.65e4-5.8e5
verdicts.reason: Independent fixed-charge energy minimisation (no archived profile, two resolutions, Richardson): e = 1 at Q = 1.766e4; thin-wall formula gives 1.34e4. Omega decreases monotonically over Q = 1.5e4-1.52e6.
Minimisation at fixed Qbar = 399.44 gives e = 0.9110861 (4e-7 off) and Omega = 0.80000; R90 5.098 with a cell-based energy cumulant (convention difference ~0.1%).

verdicts.claim: Branch-1 fragmentation gamma_max = 0.0045/0.0448/0.1121/0.2264 at x = 0.01/0.1/0.25/0.5; k_max = 0.4035; small-x law 0.450 x, 0.949 sqrt(x)

verdicts.claim: Codex a69bd86 REVIEW: the model cannot yet make a discriminating empirical prediction because identified inputs or calculations are missing
verdicts.reason: REVIEW.md states this verbatim; nothing found here yields a Candidate-1-specific observable. Every channel that comes near reach (biased-class debris free streaming, PTA-band GW tail, latest-supply free streaming) is controlled by [P] inputs (f, m0, T_ann, supply form, beta_i) and is generic to Z2 walls.

verdicts.claim: reach strengthening: every gravity-only channel at v ~ 1 TeV sits 3.7-25 decades below current or planned reach (SIDM >= 10.4, lambda_fs >= 3.7, M_cut >= 11, lensing >= 25, N_eff <= 1.7e-12, GW <= 2.5e-17 in PTA band)
verdicts.reason: Overstated as a uniform margin. Biased-class debris near T_safe: lambda_fs = 4.9e-5 / 3.6e-3 / 0.28 Mpc for f = 1/0.1/0.01, i.e. 2.8 / 0.9 / -1 decades from 0.03 Mpc. PTA-band GW including the f^-1 tail: <= 4.8e-16 (f = 0.01) at 2e-9 Hz, not 2.5e-17. Lensing >= 25 decades is an estimate from per-cell fragment charge; the hard causal ceiling at the fragmentation floor (1.7e-10-9.4e-10 Msun) lies inside microlensing reach. SIDM margin vs forecasts (0.01 cm^2/g) is 9.4 decades. Cold-class numbers (lambda_fs, sigma/m, M_cut, N_eff) reproduce for a cold-condensate supply.
verdicts.independent_value: cold class: 3.7-25 dec (estimates); biased class near T_safe: 2.8 to -1 dec in free streaming; GW tail <= 5e-16

verdicts.claim: reach estimate (Claude c7b8480 left GW of early-decaying networks uncomputed): Omega_gw h^2 <~ 2.5e-19 f^-2 (MeV/T_ann)^2; benchmark 3e-22 / 2e-18 / 6.5e-14 for f = 1/0.1/0.01; <= 2.5e-17 inside the PTA band
verdicts.reason: REPORT.md line 301 does say GWs were not computed. Cap coefficient reproduced (2.47e-19) and f = 1, 0.1 benchmarks reproduced (2.97e-22, 2.20e-18). f = 0.01: the track's step table has g* = 5.3 at 0.31 MeV (computed 8.98), giving 6.5e-14, which exceeds its own relic cap there; computed value 3.5e-14 at 3.4e-11 Hz. The PTA-band ceiling ignores the f^-1 UV tail of networks peaking below the band: <= 4.8e-20 f^-2 at 2e-9 Hz (benchmark f = 0.01 network: 6e-16). reach.py's text string says 1.6e-19.
